name: branding-minimal-black-logo-letterhead-with-slash-footer-bar
title: Minimal Black Letterhead with Slash Footer
whatItIs: A grey backdrop with a white A4 sheet: a bold black LOGO at the top left, a small address at the top right, a dated letter with a script signature and a black footer bar with contact items divided by a white diagonal slash, and below it another sheet with a green outlined logo.
whatItMeans: Almost no decoration makes the page feel serious and easy to reuse, and one slash in the footer adds a small graphic signature.
techniques: Bold wordmark and tiny address as the only header
Footer bar with a diagonal notch
Script signature for a personal touch
Plenty of white space around the letter
Second sheet using a coloured outline logo

vocabulary.definition: A solid strip at the base of a page holding contact items.
A diagonal cut used to divide items in a bar.
